s: strI, (hareRa saha gOrI .) ardDanAroSvaramUrttiH । yaTA, -- devyuvAca । “yaTA tavAhaM satataM CAyevAnugatA hara । BaveyaM sAhacaryyeRa taTA mAM kattumarhasi ॥ mavvagAtreRa saMsparSaM nityAliNganaviBramam । ahamicCAmi BavatastattvaM cet karttumarhasi ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । rocate tanmahyamapi yattvamicCasi BAvini ! । tatrotAyamahaM vakzye yadi Saknozi tat kuru ॥ adDaM mama SarIrasya gfhASa tvaM manohare । adDaM BavA me nArI taTEvArdDa pumAniti ॥ yadi tvaM na hi Saknozi harttuM tattvardDamIdfSam । tadAhaM te harizyAmi SarIrArdDaM varAnane ! ॥ tavEvArdDaM taTA nArI ardDaM Bavatu pUruzaH । vidyate tatra Saktirme tvamanujYAtumarhasi ॥ SrIdevyuvAca । “tavevAhaM hArazyAmi SarIrArdDaM vfzaDvaja ! । kintvahaM tvekamicCAmi yaccettvaM hara icCasi ॥ taTAhamardDaM Bavato hftvA tizWAmi tAvatA । tyajAmyahaM yadA te'rdDaM sampUrRaM syAttadA dvayam ॥ ityardDaBAgaharaRaM Bavedyadi yaTepsitam । tadEvAhaM tadA SamBoH SarIrArdDaM harAmyaham ॥” ISvara uvAca । evamastu BavennityaM yaTA tvaM karttumicCasi । SarIrArdDasya haraRaM BUyAttava yaTepsitam ॥ SrIOrvva uvAca । aTa gOrI tadA pUrvvamanuBUtaM tapaHsTitO । yoganidrAsvarUpaM tadAtmAno'cintayadDiyA ॥ haraM praRamya praTamaM brahmARaYca tataH param । tatastrijagatAmISaM hariM nArAyaRaM praBum ॥ cintayitvA taTA tezAmekatAM sA jaganmayI । AtmAnaM yAganidrAYca cintayitvA manasvinI ॥ dakziRe svaSarIrasya BAgArdDaM SaSaBfdBftaH । SarIrasya taTA vAmamatipremRA nijaM hare ॥ haro'pi svaSarIrArdDaM gOrIkAye tadA svayam । premRAniveSayattasyAScikIrzuH priyamadButam ॥ aTa sTitvA tadA BargaH kAlyA saha ciraM tadA । parityajya SarIrArdDaM pfTageva baBO rucA ॥ kAlI BUtvA svarRagOrI SarIrArdDantu SANkaram । prApya modAttadAtmAnaM santuzwA ca jagamBayI ॥ evaM yadA SarIrArdDamAdAya parameSvarI । harasya tizWati tadA rAjate'tIvaSoBanA । ardDaM DammilasaMyuktaM jawAjUwArdDayojitam । ekasmin SravaRe BogI BAge jAmbfnadAcitam । kuRqalaM SravaRe'nyasmin SIrze tasyA vyarAjata ॥ ardDaM mfgAkzi cAsyArdDaM vfzaBAkzi vyarAjata । ardDaM sTUlanasaM cAru tilapuzpanasaM param ॥ dorGaSmaSru taTEvArdDamardDaM SmaSruvivarjjitam । AraktacArudaSanaM raktOGamekatastaTA ॥ aparaM SuklavipuladIrGAkfti radaM param । ardDaM nIlagalaYcAdDamaparaM hArasaMyutam ॥ ardDaM kaNkaRakeyUrayuktabAhu taTAparam । nAgakeyUrasaMyuktasTUlabAhu nirUrmmikam ॥ ardDaM vizAyataBujaM karihastaBujaM param । ekatra sormmikAH SAKAH karasyAnyatra tAM vinA ॥ ekastanantu hfdayaM romAvalyardDvasaMyutam । ramBAstamBasamAnoru supArzRi mfdupAdakam ॥ ekaM taTAparaM sTUlasaMhatoru padAmbujam । ekaYcAru mfdu sTUlajaGanaM sumanoharam ॥ taTAparaM dfQakawi saMhatordDvapadAmbujam । ekaM vEyAvracarmmopayuktaM BUtivilepanam ॥ aparaM mfdukOzeyavasanaM candanokzitam । evamardDaM taTA jAtaM yIzillakzaRasaMyutam ॥ aparaM balavadBUri sudfQaM puruzAkfti evamardDaM smararipArjjahAra girijA satI ॥ hitAya sarvvajagatAM kAmAKyA kAlikopamA । tasyAH SarIraM rAjendra haratanvardDasaMyutam । yenopameyaM tannAsti mArgitaM Buvanatraye ॥ santAnaH pArijAto vA ekAntavizadastaruH । amoGayA taTA vandyO tO cApi yayaturnahi ॥ bahuDA ca pfTaktvena tO remAte nareSvara । ardDanAroSvaro BUtvA sa tu rama kadAcana ॥ iti yadyapi BUteSaH svayaM Saknoti kAlikAm । gOrIM karttuM tadA sarvvaBUtakAraRakAraRaH ॥ taTApi tAM girisutAM saMyojya viviDEH purA । tapasyayojayaddeva kriyo pAyEranekaSaH ॥ taponirDUtasarvvANgIM paScAdgOrImaTAkarot । ardDaYca pradadO tasyaM SarIrasya maheSvaraH ॥ nEvAsya tattvaM jAnanti SakrAdyAH sakalAH surAH । SarIrArdDapradAnasya tapaso yojanasya ca ॥ etasya tattvaM jAnanti mahAtmAno mahAbalAH । nandI BfNgI mahAkAlo vetAlo BEravastaTA । aNgaBUtA maheSasya vItaBItAstapoDanAH ॥ ye mAnuzaSarIreRa prApire tapaso balAt । gaRAnAmADipatyantu te jAnanti haraM param ॥ evaM sadA tvayA yojyAH sAnugA nfpasattama ! । vanitAH satkriyopAyEstato BadramavApsyasi ॥ ya idaM SfRuyAnnityamadButaM puRyadAyakam । SivayoH prItikaraRaM SarIrArdDaM grahaM taTA ॥ gOrItvApAdanaYcEva kAlikAyAH SuBAvaham । na tasya viGnA jAyante sa ca puRyatamo mataH । dIrGAyuH sa suKI BUyAt puttrapIttrasamanvitaH ॥ satataM pariSfRvAnaH SivayoScaritaM mahat । SivalAkamavApnoti suciraM SivallaBaH ॥” iti SrIkAlikApurARe 44 aDyAyaH ।

a: हरिश्चंद्रः — N. of a king of the solar dynasty. [He was the son of Triśanku and was famous for his liberality, probity, and unflinching adherence to truth. On one occasion his family-priest Vasiṣṭha commended his qualities in the presence of Viśvāmitra, who refused to believe them. A quarrel thereupon ensued, and it was at last decided that Viśvāmitra should himself test the king. The sage accordingly subjected him to the most crucial test with a view to see if he could not be but once made to swerve from his plighted word. The king, however, stood the test with exemplary courage, adhering to his word though he had to forego the kingdom, to sell off his wife and son, and at last, even his own self to a low-caste man, and-as the last test, as it were, of his truthfulness and courage-to be even ready to put his own wife to death as a witch! Viśvāmitra there-upon acknowledged himself vanquished, and the worthy king was elevated along with his subjects to heaven].

N. of the 28th king of the solar dynasty in the Tretā age (he was son of Tri-śaṅku, and was celebrated for his piety; accord. to the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa he gave up his country, his wife and his son, and finally himself, to satisfy the demands of Viśvāmitra; after enduring incredible sufferings, he won the pity of the gods and was raised with his subjects to heaven : accord. to MBh. ii, 489 &c., his performance of the Rāja-sūya sacrifice was the cause of his elevation, and in the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa quite another legend is told about him, see under शुनःशेप, p. 1082, col. 3 : in later legends Hari-ścandra is represented as insidiously induced by Nārada to relate his actions with unbecoming pride, whereupon he was degraded from Svarga, one stage at each sentence, till stopping in time and doing homage to the gods he was fixed with his capital in mid-air ; his aerial city is popularly believed to be still visible in the skies at particular times; cf. सौभ), Br.; MaitrUp.; MBh. &c.

s: [n] klI, (harernAma .) SrIharerAKyAnam । tanmAhAtmyaM yaTA, -- “na kAlaniyamastatra na deSaniyamastaTA । nocCizwAdI nizeDo'sti harernAmani lubDaka ॥ jYAnaM devArccanaM DyAnaM DAraRA niyamo yamaH । pratyAhAraH samADiSca harinAmasamaM na ca ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe 98 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । “harernAma harernAma harernAmEva kevalam । kalO nAstyeva nAstyeva nAstyeva gatiranyaTA ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAsasya 11 vilAse bfhannAradIyapurARavacanam ॥ * ॥ vEzRavAnAM japyaharinAmAni yaTA, -- “hare kfzRa hare kfzRa kfzRa kfzRa hare hare । hare rAma hare rAma rAma rAma hare hare ॥” asya pramARAdi yaTA, -- tripurovAca । “vAsudeva mahAbAho ! SfRuzva paramaM vacaH । tvaM hi deva suraSrezWaH kimarTaM tapyate tapaH ॥ kulAcAraM vinA puttra ! nahi sidDiH prajAyate । SaktihInasya te sidDiH kaTaM Bavati re suta ! ॥ mamAMSasamBavAM lakzmIM tyaktvA kiM tapyate tapaH । vfTA SramaM vfTA pUjAM japaYca viPalaM suta ! ॥ saMyogaM kuru yatnena SaktyA saha tapoDana ! । suKaM vinA sutaSrezWa ! vidyAsidDirnna jAyate ॥ sADake kzoBamApanne devatA kzoBamApnuyAt । tasmAdBogayuto BUtvA japakarmma samAraBet ॥ BogaM vinA sutaSrezWa ! nahi BokzaH prajAyate । SfRu puttra sutaSrezWa dIkzAyA AnupUrvvikIm ॥ daSavarze tu saMprApte dvAdaSAByantare suta ! । SfRuyAdDarinAmAni zoqaSAni pfTak pfTak । harinAma vinA puttra ! karRaSudDirnna jAyate ॥ SrIvAsudeva uvAca । SfRu mAtarmmahAmAye viSvabIjasvarUpiRi ! । harinAma mahAmAye kramAttava mataM vada ॥ * ॥ tripurovAca । hare kfzRa hare kfzRa kfzRa kfzRa hare hare । hare rAma hare rAma rAma rAma hare hare ॥ dvAtriMSadakzarARyevaM kalAnAmamftaM sadA । SfRu cCandaH sutaSrezWa ! harinAmnastu cEva hi ॥ Cando hi paramaM guhyaM mahat padamanavyayam । sarvvaSaktimayaM tantraM harinAma tapoDana ! ॥” * ॥ asya SrIharinAmamantrasya vAsudeva fzirgAyattrI cCandaH SrItripurA devatA mama mahAvidyAsidDyarTe viniyogaH ॥ * ॥ “etanmantraM sutaSrezWa ! praTamaM SfRuyAnnaraH । SrutvA dvijamuKAt puttra dakzakarRe tapoDana ! ॥ AdO Candastato mantraM SrutvA SudDo BavennaraH । dvAdaSAByantare SrutvA karRaSudDimavApnuyAt ॥ karRaSudDiM vinA puttra mahAvidyAmupAlaBet । nArI vA puruzo vApi tatkzaRAnnArakI Bavet ॥ tatastu zoqaSe varze saMprApte suravandita ! । mahAvidyAM tataH SudDAM nityAM brahmasvarUpiRIm । SrutvA kulamuKAdviprAt sAkzAt brahmamayo Bavet । kuryyAdetadrahasyaM yaH SivoktaYca tapoDana ! । tasya sidDirBavedvidyA azwESvaryyamavApnuyAt ॥ rahasyaM hi vinA puttra ! Srama eva hi kevalam । ataeva sutaSrezWa ! rahasyarahitastava । rahasyarahitAM vidyAM na japettu kadAcana ॥ * ॥ hakArastu sutaSrezWa ! SivaH sAkzAnna saMSayaH । rePastu cipurAdevI mama mUrttimayI sadA ॥ ekAraYca BagaM vidyAt sAkzAdyoniM tapoDana ! । ekAraH SUnyarUpI ca rePo vigrahaDAriRaH । hare tu tripurA sAkzAnmama mUrttirnna saMSayaH ॥ kakAraH kAmadA kAmarUpiRI sPuradavyayam । fkAraSca sutaSrezWa ! jyezWA SaktiritoritA ॥ kakAraSca fkAraSca kAminI vEzRavI kalA ॥ zakAraScandramA devaH kalAzoqaSasaMyutaH ॥ RakAraSca sutavara ! sAkzAnnirvfttirUpiRI । dvayorEkyaM tapaHSrezWa ! mahAmAyA jaganmayI ॥ kfzRa kfzRa sutaSrezWa ! mahAmAyA jaganmayI । hare hare tato devi ! SivaSaktisvarUpiRI ॥ hare rAmeti ca padaM SivaSaktimayaM suta ! । hare hare iti padaM Saktidvayasamanvitam ॥ Adyante praRavaM dattvA yo japeddaSaDA dvijaH । sa Bavet sutavara ! SrezWo mahAvidyAsu sundaraH ॥ harinAma sutaSrezWa ! jyezWaM tu vEzRavaM matam ॥ evaM zoqaSa nAmAni dvAtriMSadakzarARi ca । Adyante praRavaM dattvA catustriM Sadanuttama ! ॥ harinAma vinA puttra ! dIkzA ca viPalA sadA । kuladevamuKAcCrutvA harinAma parAkzaram ॥ brAhmaRakzattravESyASca SUdraH SrutvA parAkzaram । dIkzAM kuryyAt sutaSrezWa ! mahAvidyAsu sundara ! ॥ dIkzAM vApi harernnAma yadi SUdramuKAt priye ! । ajYAnAdyadi gfhRIyAt tasya pApaPalaM SfRu ॥ SUdraH SUdramuKAt SrutvA vidyAM vA mantramuttamam । kowivaMSAn samAdAya rOravaM prati gacCati । api dAtfgfhItrorvA dvayorapi samaM Palam ॥ brahmahatyAmavApnoti akzaraM akzaraM prati । SfRu puttra ! vAsudevaprasaNgAdvacanaM mama ॥” iti SrIvAsudevamAhAtmye rADAtantre tripurAvAsudevasaMvAde dvitIyapawalaH ॥

a: हरित् — a. [हृ-इति] 1 Green, green ish. --2 Yellow, yellowish. --3 Greenish-yellow. --m. 1 The green or yellow colour. --2 A horse of the sun, a bay horse; सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरींश्च वर्तते वाजिनः Ś. 1.; दिशो हरिद्भिर्हरितामिवेश्वरः R. 3. 30, Ku. 2. 43. --3 A swift horse. --4 A lion. --5 The sun --6 Viṣṇu. --7 The kidneybean. --m. n. 1 Grass. --2 A quarter, region. --3 A quarter or point of the compass; R. 3. 30. --4 Turmeric (usually f. only in the last {3} senses). --COMP. --अंतः the end of the quarters (दिगंत); Bv. 1. 60. --अंतरं different regions, various quarters; Bv. 1. 15. --अश्वः the sun; Ki. 2. 46; R. 3. 22, 18. 23; Śi. 11. 56. {2} the arka plant. --गर्भः green or yellowish Kuśa grass with broad leaves. --पर्णं a radish. --मणिः (हरिन्मणिः) an emerald; Śi. 3. 49. --वर्ण a. greenish, green-coloured.

piRqasaMjYakam । tayorAdyaM guREH SrezWaM tato hInaguRaM param ॥ svarRavarRaM guru snigDaM sapatraM cABrapatravat । patrAKyaM tAlakaM vidyAt guRAQyaM tadrasAyanam ॥ nizpatraM piRqasadfSaM sfjati ca bahutApAnaNgasaNkocapIqAH । vitarati kaPavAtO kuzWarogaM vidaDyAdidamasitamaSudDaM mAritaM cApyasamyak ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ * ॥ aTa tAlasyASudDasya dozamAha । “aSudDaM tAlamAyurhft kaPamArutamehakft । tApasPowANgasaMkocAn kurute tena SoDayet ॥” aTa tAlakasya SoDanaviDiH । “tAtakaM kaRaSaH kftvA taccUrRaM kAYjike kzipet । dolAyantreRa yAmEkaM tataH kuzmARqaje drave ॥ tilatEle pacedyAmaM yAmaYca triPalArase । dolAyantre caturyAmaM pakvaM SuDyati tAlakam ॥” * ॥ aTa tAlakasya mAraRaviDiH । “sadalaM tAlakaM SudDaM pOnarnavarasena tu । Kalle vimarddayedekaM dinaM paScAdviSoDayet ॥ saMSoDya golakaM tasya kuryyAttacca viSoDayet । tataH punarnavAkzArEH sTAlyAmardDaM prapUrayet ॥ tatra tadgolakaM DftvA punastenEva pUrayet । AkaRWaM piWaraM tasya piDAnaM DArayenmuKe ॥ sTAlIM cUlyAM samAropya kramAdvahniM vivardDayet । dinAnyantaraSUnyAni paYcavahniM pradIpayet ॥ evaM tanmriyate tAlaM mAtrA tasyEkarattikA । anupAnAnyanekAni yaTAyogyaM prayojayet ॥” evaM SoDitasya mAritasya tAlakasya guRAH । “haritAlaM kawu snigDaM kazAyozRaM haredvizam । kaRqukuzWAsyarAgAsrakaPapittakacavraRAn ॥” anyacca । “tAlakaM harate rogAn kuzWamftyujvarApaham । SoDitaM kurute kAntiM vIryyavfdDiM taTAyuzaH ॥” iti ca BAvaprakASaH ॥

s: strI, dUrvvA । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ sOraBAdraSuklacaturTI haritAlikA । sOraBAdrakfzRacaturTyAmuditacandrasya nazwacandra iti saMjYA । iti paYjikAyAM prasidDA । tatra candradarSananizeDo yaTA । BojadevaH । “Suklapakze caturTyAntu siMhe candrasya darSanam । miTyABiSApaM kurute na paSyettatra tantataH ॥” caturTyAM darSananizeDyat tatroditasya candrasya paYcamyAM darSane tu na dozaH । ataH । “paYcAnanagate BAnO pakzayoruBayorapi । caturTyAmuditaScandro nekzitavyaH kadAcana ॥” caturTyAM nekzitavya iti muniBirudita ukta ityarTaH । aTavA caturTyAmityasya praDAnakriyAnvayAByarhitatvAdIkzitavya ityanenAnvayo na tUdita ityanena । taTA ca avyaktaM praDAnagAmi iti sUtreavyaktasya Sabdasya praDAnena saha sambanDa iti BawwanArAyaRavyAKyAnaM iti । uditastvardDoditavyAvfttiparaH svarUpAKyAnaparo vA । “brAhmaRI tu SunA dazwA jambukozwreRa vA gavA । uditaM somanakzatraM dfzwvA sadyaH SucirBavet ॥” iti parASaroktodita itivat ॥ * ॥ nanvekapadasya kaTamanekArTatA iti cenna yAvanto'rTAstAvanti padAnIti । taTA coktam । “yAvatAmeva DAtUnAM liNgaM rUQigataM Bavet । arTaScEvABiDeyastu tAvadBirguRavigrahaH ॥” SiNgaM samArTam । rUQigataM prasidDam । na tvaprasidDam । hana hiMsAgatyorityAdO gamanAdikam । aBiDeyo vAcyaH । tAvadBirDAtuBirguRavigraho guRErgaRanABirvigraho grahaRaM yatrArTe sa taTA । etena DAtusamasaMKyArTatvaM padasya । brahmapurARe siMhArkADikAre । “nArAyaRo'BiSaptastu niSAkaramarIcizu । sTitaScaturTyAmadyApi manuzyAya patecca saH ॥ ataScaturTyAM candrantu pramAdAdvIkzya mAnavaH । paWedDAtreyikAvAkyaM prANmuKo nApyudaNmuKaH ॥ aBiSaptaH parIvAdavizayIBUtaH । so'BiSApaH । DAtreyikAvAkyaM vizRupurARe । “siMhaH prasenamavaDIt siMho jAmbavatA hataH । sukumAraka mA rodIstava hyeza syamantakaH ॥” anena mantreRABimantritaM jalaM peyaM AcArAt syamantakopAKyAnaYca Srotavyam । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥

pittahft kaPahfttu sA । kawutiktakazAyatvAdamlatvAdvAtahfcCivA ॥ pittakft kawukAmlatvAt vAtahfnna kaTaM SivA । praBAvAddozahantftvaM sidDaM yattat prakASyate ॥ hetuBiH SizyaboDArTaM na pUrvvaM kriyate'DunA । karmmaRyatvaM guREH sAmyaM dfzwamASrayaBedataH । yatastato neti cintyaM DAtrIlakucayoryaTA ॥ payyAyA majjani svAduH snAyAvamlo vyavasTitaH । vfnte tiktastvaci kawurasTisTastavaro rasaH KAdet ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “jIvantI rohiRI cEva vijayA cABayAmftA । pUtanA kAlikA ceti saptajAtirharItakI ॥ suvarRavarRA jIvantI rohiRI kapiladyutiH । alAvuvfttA vijayA paYcAMSA cABayA smftA ॥” paYcAMSA paYcaSirA । “sTUlamAMsAmftA jYeyA pUtanAsTimatI matA । tryaMSA ca kAliketyevaM saptajAtirharItakI ॥ snehapAnezu sarvvezu jIvantI tu praSasyate । rohiRI kzatarogezu vijayA sarvakarmmasu ॥ pUtanA lepane jYeyA amftA tu virecane । aBayA netrarogezu ganDayuktO tu kAlikA ॥ harasya Bavane jAtA haritA ca svaBAvataH । harate sarvvarogAMSca tena nAmnA harItakI ॥ * ॥ pIyUzaM pibatastripizwapapaterye vindavo nirgatAsteByo'BUdaBayA divAkarakaraSreRIva dozApahA । kAlindIva balapramodajananI gIrIva SUlipriyA vahnidyotakarI hutAhutiriva kzORIva nAnArasA ॥ paTyA paYcarasAyuzyA cakzuzyAlavaRA sarA । meDyozRA dIpanI kuzWadozaSoTabraRAprahA ॥” * ॥ paYcarasasya vivaraRam । tvak kawuH । mAMsaM amla kazAyam । asTi tiktam । tanmaDye mADuryyam ॥ * ॥ tanmajjagaRAH । “paTyAmajjA tu cakzuzyo vAtapittaharo guruH ॥” iti rAjavallamaH ॥

SrIharerddinam । tattu ekAdaSIdvAdaSItiTirUpam । yaTA, -- “ekAdaSI dbAdaSI ca proktA SrIcakrapARinaH ॥” “ekAdaSImuposyEva dvAdaSIM samupozayet । na cAtra viDilopaH syAduBayordevatA hariH ॥” iti ca tiyyAditattvam ॥ api ca । “yAni kAni ca pApAni brahmahatyAdikAni ca । annamASritya sarvvARi tizWanti harivAsare ॥ aGaM sa kevalaM BuNkte yo BuNkte harivAsare ॥” ityekAdaSItattvam ॥ * ॥ dvAdaSyAH praTamapAdaH । yaTA । vizRuDarmmottare । “dvAdaSyAH praTamaH pAdo harivAsarasaMjYakaH । tamatikramya kurvvIta pAraRaM vizRutatparaH ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ * ॥ aTa harivAsare jAgaraRAdiviDiH । skAnde SrobrahmanAradasaMvAde । “SfRu nArada ! vakzyAmi jAgarasya tu lakzaRam । yena vijYAtamAtreRa durlaBo na janArddanaH ॥ gItaM vAdyaM ca nftyaM ca purARapaWanaM taTA । DUpaM dIpaM ca nEvedyaM puzpaganDAnulepanam ॥ PalamarGyaYca SradDA ca dAnamindriyanigrahaH । satyAnvitaM vinidraYca mudA yuktaM kriyAnvitam ॥ sAScaryyaM cEva sotsAhaM pApAlasyAdivarjjitam । pradakziRABisaMyuktaM namaskArapuraHsaram ॥ norAjanasamAyuktamanirviRRena cetasA । yAme yAme mahABAga ! kuryyAdArAtrikaM hareH । etErguREH samAyuktaM kuryyAjjAgaraRaM hareH ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “ya evaM kurute BaktyA vittaSAWyavivarjjataH । jAgaraM vAsare vizRorlIyate paramAtmani ॥ DanavAn vittaSAWyena yaH karoti prajAgaram । tenAtmA hArito nUnaM kitavena durAtmanA ॥” tatrEva SrImadumAmaheSvarasaMvAde । “saSAstraM jAgaraM yacca nftyagAnDarvvasaMyutam । savAdyaM tAlasaMyuktaM sadIpaM sADuBiryutam ॥ upacArESca saMyuktaM yaToktErBaktiBAvitEH । manasastuzwijananaM samudaM lokaraYjanam ॥ guRErdvAdaSaBiryuktaM jAgaraM mADavapriyam । karttavyaM tat prayatnena pakzayoH SuklakfzRayoH ॥” * ॥ kiYca । “parApavAdayuktaM tu manaH praSamavarjjitam । SAstrahInamagAnDarvvaM taTA dIpavivarjjitam ॥ SaktyopacArarahitamudAsInaM sanidrakam । kaliyuktaM viSezeRa jAgaraM navaDADamam ॥” * ॥ kiYca । tatrEva । “aBAve vAcakasyATa gItaM nftyaYca kArayet । vAcake sati deveSi ! purARaM praTamaM paWet ॥” * ॥ aTa jAgaraRanityatvam । skAnde brahmanAradasavAde । “atItAnAgatAn vApi pAtayizyanti pUrvvajAn । akurvvARAH prapatsyanti puttraDarmmavasukzayam । jAyate narake vAsaH pitfBiH saha kAlaSaH ॥ na puraScaraRAt pApaM vratErdAnEH samADiBiH । vilayaM yAti viprendra ! vinA dvAdaSIjAgaram ॥” tatrEvomAmaheSvarasaMvAde । “saMprAptaM jAgare vizRorye na kurvvanti jAgaram । BraSyate sukftaM tezAM vEzRavAnAYca nindayA ॥ matirna jAyate yasya dvAdaSyAM jAgaraM prati । na hi tasyADikAro'sti pUjane keSavasya hi ॥” ataevoktaM brahmaRA । tatrEva । “hfdaye varttate yasya sadA yogeSvaro hariH । matirutpadyate tasya dvAdaSIjAgaropari ॥ * ॥ sAmAnDena purAleKi gItanftyAdinityatA । aDunA liKyate seyaM jAgare ca viSezataH ॥” aTa jAgare gItAdinityatvam । skAnde umAmaheSvarasaMvAde । “mUkavattizWate yo vE gAnaM pAWaYca nAcaret । sapta janmAni mUkatvaM jAyate jAgare hareH ॥ yo na nftyati mUQAtmA purato jAgare hareH । paNgutvaM jAyate tasya sapta janmAdi pArvvati ! ॥ pAdme pakzavardDanIprasaNge । “stuvanti na praSaMsanti ye janA jAgaraM hare । notsavo Bavate tezAM gfhe janmAni sapta ca ॥ stuvanti ye praSaMsanti jAgaraM cakrapARinaH । nityotsavo BavettezAM janmAni daSa paYca ca ॥” aTa jAgaMraRamAhAtmyam । skAndebrahmanAradasaMvAde taTA SrIprahrAdasaMhitAyAYca । “na gayApiRqadAnena na tIrTErbahuBirmaKEH । pUrvvajA muktimAyAnti vinA dvAdaSIjAgaram ॥ sarvvAvasTo'pi yaH kuryyAdGAdaSyAM jAgaraM hareH । yAmenEkena dahate pApaM janmasahasrajam ॥ * ॥ yaH kuryyAddIpadAnantu rAtrO jAgaraRe hareH ॥ nimize nimize vripra ! laBate goSataM Palam ॥ yaH kuryyAjjAgare pUjAM dvAdaSyAM kusumErhareH । puzpe puzpe'SvameDasya PalamApnoti mAnavaH ॥ yo daheccAguruM vizRoH pUjAM kftvA tu jAgare । nimizArdDena laBate tilapAtraSataM Palam ॥ nimezaYca dahedDUpaM saGftaM gugguluM hareH । laBate jAgare vipra ! puRyaM mAsasamudBavam ॥ yo dadyAjjAgare vizRorhavizyAnnasamudBavam ॥ nEvedyaM laBate puRyaM SAliSElasamudBavam ॥ pakvAnnAni ca yo dadyAt PalAni viviDAni ca । jAgare padmanABasya laBate go'yutaM Palam ॥ sakarpUraYca tAmbUlaM yo dadAti hi jAgare । padmanABaprasAdena SvetadvIpe vasecciram ॥ jAgare padmanABasya yaH kuryyAt puzpamaRqapam । sa puzpakavimAnEstu krIqate brahmasadmani ॥ jAgare padmanABasya sakarpUraM taTAgurum । dahate dahate pApaM janmalakzasamudBavam ॥ snAnaM dadAti kfzRasya daDikzIraGftAdiBiH । rAtrO jAgaraRe viprA ! muktiBAgI BavedDi saH ॥ divyAmbarARi yo dadyAjjAgare samupasTite । manvantarARi vasate tantumaMKyAsamAni vE ॥ dadyAdABaraRaM vizRArhemajaM ratnasamBavam । saptakalpAni vasate sotsaNge matpriyo hi saH ॥ SrIcandanaM sakarpUraM sAguruM tu sakeSaram । yuktaM mfgamadenApi yacCate harijAgare ॥ ekEkaM muniSArdUla ! aSvameDADikaM Palam । kalO Bavenna sandeho vAsudevaprasAdataH ॥ Gftena dIpakaM vizRorgavyena ca viSezataH । jvAlayejjAgare rAtrO nimeze go'yutaM Palam ॥ jAgare vAsudevasya karpUreRa ca dIpakam । yo jvAlayati kowInAM kapilAnAM laBet Palam । ArAtrikaM hareryastu sakarpUrantu jAgare । kurute mokzamApnoti kulAyutasamanvitaH ॥ vinA hi yo'pi karpUraM kuryyAdArAtrikaM hareH ॥ niHsvo'pi jAgare vizRordAtA BUriPalaM laBet ॥ vArijaM vAriRA pUrRaM Sirasi snApayedDarim । biBartti SirasA so'yaM gaNgAsnAnakftaM Palam ॥ kftvA pUjAM hareryastu jAgare purataH SuciH । paWennAmasahasrantu gItAM nAgavimokzaRam ॥ mANgalyasnapanaM puRyaM stavarAjamanusmftim । vEdikAni va japyAni BaktyA rAtrO muhurmuhuH ॥ Bavet pratyakzaraM puRyaM kapilAgoSatodBavam । jAgare yajYarUpasya purataH paWato hareH ॥ yaH punaH kurute gItaM sanftyaM vAdyasaMyutam । na tat kratuSatEH puRyaM vratadAnaSatErapi ॥ yaH punaH kurute gItaM vilajjo nftyate yadi । laBate nimizArdDena caturASramajaM Palam ॥ jAgare padmanABasya kuryyAt pustakavAcanam । SlokasaMKyAM vaset svarge yugAni harisanniDO ॥ kuryyAdvandanamAlAM yo ramBAstamBEH
